key_insight: WC–Co–Cr coating properties depend on powder morphology and spray method: detonation spraying favors hardness, while HVOF provides a dense, uniform coating with low friction.
engineering_relevance: Selecting the powder and deposition route can improve coating performance for machine parts exposed to intensive friction and high loads.
method: Compared detonation-sprayed and HVOF WC–Co–Cr coatings.
Examined powder morphology and coating microstructure using SEM and EDS.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an average microhardness of 1449 HV for detonation-sprayed coatings and a friction coefficient of Kt = 0.143 for HVOF coatings.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test conditions or statistical variability, limiting assessment of performance under service loads.
paper_title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
